scope: Error-only records from the full-test reliability model; this file contains misclassified windows, not all test predictions.
interpretation: False positives substantially outnumber false negatives in this error-only file.
False-positive windows have a mean fake score around 0.564, indicating that many are not extremely high-confidence outputs.
False-negative windows have a mean fake score around 0.479, close to the 0.5 binary decision threshold.
This file does not contain correctly classified windows, so it cannot independently reproduce accuracy, precision, recall, F1, or ROC-AUC.
Repeated windows from the same source video are not independent observations.
